_readme: Copy this to config.json and fill it in. Defaults are fully free/local (Ollama + Whisper + browser voice) and need no API keys. For nicer speech, add an ElevenLabs key and set tts_provider to 'elevenlabs'.
_language: 'en' (English) or 'tr' (Turkish) — the language E.V. listens, thinks and speaks in.
_memory: history_turns: how many recent messages stay in context (raise for long chats / RP). num_ctx: Ollama context window in tokens. Larger needs more VRAM; if VRAM is free you can raise it to 8192, and E.V. auto-falls-back to a smaller window when the GPU is busy (e.g. a game is running).
